title: Quotation Item-Level Discount and Real-Time Margin Rule Integration
description: Move discount input from quotation grand total to item-level (per part) with flexible %/Rp selection. Integrate item-level discounts directly into real-time margin evaluation and approval engine so sub-standard margins correctly trigger tiered approvals.
completion_notes:
1. Updated app/dashboard/quotations/_components/quotation-form.tsx: added Discount column to TableHeader and TableRows (Desktop & Mobile) with flexible % / Rp selection per part; removed manual discount input from grand total; Totals Summary displays auto-calculated Total Discount; updated liveMarginSummary to calculate net effective price per item.
2. Updated app/actions/approval-engine.ts: evaluateQuotationMargin, submitQuotationForApproval, and getQuotationApprovalDetail now take item discount into account when computing effective unit price and margin percent.
3. Updated app/dashboard/quotations/_components/quotation-pdf-preview.tsx and quotation-pdf-generator.ts: item rows show line discounts and amounts reflect net discounted amounts; totals section correctly formats gross Sub Total and item-level discount accumulation.
4. Verified with vitest: 11 tests in quotation-approval-engine.test.ts passing including new discount-margin tests.
